title: Watchtower Labs Raises $35M Seed to Fix US Military Logistics
summary:
A stealth-mode defense firm has emerged to optimize how the Pentagon manages its supply chains using specialized AI models. Watchtower Labs has raised $35 million in seed funding to develop software that assists the U.S. Armed Forces in making complex logistical decisions. The startup is already running pilots with several U.S. military commands and is led by CEO Akhil Iyer, a former U.S. Marines veteran.

The company's technology combines large language models with in-house simulation software that can run on local, secret data to maintain security. Watchtower was incubated by Shield Capital and is backed by investors including Conviction, In-Q-Tel, and Founders Fund. Inspired by discussions with Admiral Paparo of U.S. Indo-Pacific Command, the firm employs nearly 30 people across the Bay Area, Seattle, Hawaii, and Washington, D.C.
